	<!-- Inject analytics-setup.js -->
	<script type="text/javascript">/* eslint-disable */
// IE prios to 9 doesn't support document.head
// even if we don't support any version of IE
// it's complicated to explain why CB is higher than GA or that we have a lot of traffic from IE in AJC
var documentHead = document.head || document.getElementsByTagName('head')[0]
var canonicalNode = documentHead.querySelector('link[rel\x3d"canonical"]')
var searchTermsNode = documentHead.querySelector('meta[name\x3d"searchTerms"]')

// Keep in sync with the identical key in src/global/components/widgets/disqus/index.js
const AJ_ANALYTICS_REDIRECT_DATA_KEY = 'aj_analytics_redirect_data'

// Hand-synced copy of src/global/analytics/amplitude/event-property-whitelist.ts;
// page-view-script.test.ts fails if they drift. Declared up here because
// sendPageView() runs before the rest of this file.
var AJ_AMPLITUDE_EVENT_PROPERTY_WHITELIST = [
	// The envelope every event carries.
	'channel',
	'sourcePlatform',
	'uCMSAmplitudeVersion',
	'screenWidth',
	'screenHeight',
	'userAgent',
	'isMobileExperience',

	// Content and placement.

	'date',

	'where',

	'articleListenOption',
	'articleSummaryAvailable',
	'readingListTopics',
	'commentsEnabled',
	'galleryLength',
	'duration',
	'destinationUrl',
	'customTopics',
	'previousPageLink',

	// Older names for the fields above; both spellings ship on the same event.
	'postLink',
	'postType',

	'postAuthor',
	'postDate',
	'postTag',
	'postWhere',

	// Video and audio.
	'videoLink',

	'videoSection',

	'videoPlacement',
	'videoSource',

	'fileURL',

	'playlistIndex',
	'autoplay',
	'click',
	'currentPosition',
	'percentageWatched',
	'watchtime',
	'watchTime',
	'stopCause',
	'subscriptionStatus',
	'sourcePlayer',
	'destinationPlayer',
	'selectedSpeed',
	'experimentID',
	'experimentVariant',
	'experimentVariantPlayerId',

	// Sharing.
	'sharePlatform',
	'sharePosition',
	'childPostTitle',
	'childPostPosition',
	'childPostVideoEmbedded',

	// Live blog and sports blog.
	'liveblogTab',
	'numberofUpdates',

	'awayTeam',

	// Accounts, newsletters, notifications.
	'signedUpFrom',

	// Homepage cards, featured gallery, ads.
	'featuredTemplate',

	// AJA v2 only.
	'depth',

	// Homepage layout context on ArticleOpen.
	'containerType',

	// The homepage article panel, on ArticleOpen.
	'presentation',

	// For You placement context.
	'topicId',
	'carouselType',

	'nudgeVariant',

	'authMethod',

	'result',

	'isNewUser',
	'fallback',

	'returnPath',

	// Ask Al Jazeera.

	'outcome',

	'utm_source',

	'utm_term',
]

// Protocol owned by src/global/analytics/pending-attribution.ts; its test
// guards these three constants against drifting from this copy.
const AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_KEY = 'aj_analytics_pending_attribution'
const AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_TTL_MS = 300000
const AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_PROPERTIES = [
	'module',
	'section',
	'index',
	'topics',
	'attributionToken',
	'containerType',
	'columnPosition',
	'cardPosition',
	'cardType',
	'topicId',
	'carouselType',
	'recirculationSource',
	'source_story_id',
	'referralSource',
]

// Chartbeat records at most 10 comma-separated section values and ignores the
// rest. The availability tag has to survive that cut, so when the combined
// list would pass 10 only the tail of the editorial sections is dropped.
// Declared up here because sendPageView() runs before the rest of this file.
var CHARTBEAT_SECTION_LIMIT = 10
var CHARTBEAT_AI_SUMMARY_SECTION = 'articleSummaryAvailable'

function chartbeatSectionParts(value) {
	var parts = []
	if (!value) {
		return parts
	}
	var raw = String(value).split(',')
	for (var i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
		if (raw[i] && raw[i] !== CHARTBEAT_AI_SUMMARY_SECTION) {
			parts.push(raw[i])
		}
	}
	return parts
}

function buildChartbeatSections(pageSection, siteModule, includeAiSummary) {
	if (!includeAiSummary) {
		if (!siteModule) {
			return pageSection
		}
		return pageSection
			? pageSection + ',zMod: ' + siteModule
			: 'zMod: ' + siteModule
	}

	var extras = []
	if (siteModule) {
		extras.push('zMod: ' + siteModule)
	}
	extras.push(CHARTBEAT_AI_SUMMARY_SECTION)
	var parts = chartbeatSectionParts(pageSection)
	var room = CHARTBEAT_SECTION_LIMIT - extras.length
	if (parts.length > room) {
		parts = parts.slice(0, room)
	}
	return parts.concat(extras).join(',')
}

// Behind the CDN the server renders the canonical on the origin's host and
// hydration swaps in the public one for the same page, which is not a new view.
function canonicalPath(href) {
	return String(href || '').replace(/^[a-z][a-z\d+.-]*:\/\/[^/]*/i, '')
}

// holding the previous canonical value allow us to detect canonical change for which we can send page views
window.previousCanonical = ''
window.previousSearchTerm = searchTermsNode ? searchTermsNode.content : ''

if (canonicalNode) {
	// NOTE:
	// This is all we need for Opera mini, as the application behave as SSR only even after navigation
	// A request is sent to opera's servers then a page is sent back as response
	// ref: https://dev.opera.com/articles/opera-mini-and-javascript

	// href vs getAttribute("href")
	// we use href as it provides home page with trailing slash
	// when we use this value in send Page view it will remove the host name keeping just the slash / which we need for analytics
	sendPageView()
}

// MutationObserver doesn't work for Opera mini, we still have decent amount of traffic from this browser even if our app is not fully supported
// Opera mini renders the page on opera servers.
if (typeof window.MutationObserver === 'function') {
	function callback(mutationsList, observer) {
		for (var index = 0; index < mutationsList.length; index++) {
			var mutation = mutationsList[index]
			var newNode = mutation.addedNodes[0]
			if (mutation.type !== 'childList' || !newNode) {
				continue
			}

			if (newNode.rel === 'canonical') {
				if (
					canonicalPath(newNode.href) !==
					canonicalPath(window.previousCanonical)
				) {
					sendPageView()
					// Don't allow observation of other nodes to help avoid double pageviews
					break
				}
			}

			// This is specific to search page only, any other page shouldn't have searchTerms meta
			// When the user change the search term, we append it as a path component but the canonical doesn't change
			// Therefore the mutation observer won't notify us about any change and we will lose page views
			// So for search page we observe searchTerms Meta if it changes then we can send a page view
			// Important note: We must send a page view in case of searchTerms update only and only if the canonical was not changed otherwise we may send duplicate page views.
			// e.g: landing on /search/article this will send a page view because of the canonical changes, not because of the searchTerms changes
			// if we change term from article to News, we endup with /search/news, this page has the same /search canonical, and we can send a page view if the searchTerms changed
			if (newNode.name === 'searchTerms' && newNode.content) {
				var searchTermsValue = newNode.content
				if (searchTermsValue !== window.previousSearchTerm) {
					sendPageView()
					break
				}
			}

			// This is to handle the case where there is no canonical but we still want to send a page view
			if (newNode.name === 'sendPageView' && newNode.content === 'true') {
				sendPageView()
				break
			}
		}
	}

	window.canonicalObserver = new MutationObserver(callback)
	window.canonicalObserver.observe(documentHead, {
		childList: true,
	})
}

function getMediaEmbeds() {
	const dwFeatured = getMetaValue('dw:featured', 'name', null)
	const dwBody = getMetaValue('dw:body', 'name', null)
	const mediaEmbeds = []
	if (dwFeatured) {
		const dwFeaturedList = dwFeatured.split(',')
		for (var i = 0; i < dwFeaturedList.length; i++) {
			mediaEmbeds.push('DW-' + dwFeaturedList[i])
		}
	}
	if (dwBody) {
		const dwBodyList = dwBody.split(',')
		for (var i = 0; i < dwBodyList.length; i++) {
			mediaEmbeds.push('DW-' + dwBodyList[i])
		}
	}
	if (mediaEmbeds.length === 0) {
		return null
	}
	return mediaEmbeds.join(', ')
}

function getMetaValueByName(metaName) {
	return getMetaValue(metaName, 'name', null)
}
// set custom dimensions
function setCustomDimensions() {
	// Dimension 01: Topics List
	gtag('set', 'dimension1', getMetaValueByName('topics'))
	// Dimension 02: Primary Topic
	gtag('set', 'dimension2', getMetaValueByName('primaryTopic'))
	// Dimension 03: Where
	gtag('set', 'dimension3', getMetaValueByName('where'))
	// Dimension 04: Tags
	gtag('set', 'dimension4', getMetaValueByName('tags'))
	// Dimension 05: Primary Tag
	gtag('set', 'dimension5', getMetaValueByName('primaryTag'))
	// Dimension 06: Content Type
	gtag('set', 'dimension6', getMetaValueByName('contentType'))
	// Dimension 07: Source Taxonomy
	gtag('set', 'dimension7', getMetaValueByName('sourceTaxonomy'))
	// Dimension 08: Taxonomy Terms
	gtag('set', 'dimension8', getMetaValueByName('taxonomyTerms'))
	// Dimension 09: Display Authors
	gtag('set', 'dimension9', getMetaValueByName('displayAuthors'))
	// Dimension 10: Featured Media
	gtag('set', 'dimension10', getMetaValueByName('featuredMedia'))
	// Dimension 11: Published Date
	gtag('set', 'dimension11', getMetaValueByName('publishedDate'))
	// Dimension 12: Program Taxonomy Terms
	gtag('set', 'dimension12', getMetaValueByName('programTaxonomy'))
	// Dimension 13: Page Type - (Landing Page | Article Page)
	gtag('set', 'dimension13', getMetaValueByName('pageType'))
	// Dimension 14: Post ID
	gtag('set', 'dimension14', getMetaValueByName('postID'))
	// Dimension 15: Platform Source
	gtag('set', 'dimension15', 'Web')
	// Dimension 16: Post Label
	gtag('set', 'dimension16', getMetaValueByName('postLabel'))
	// Dimension 17: Last Updated Date
	gtag('set', 'dimension17', getMetaValueByName('lastDate'))
	// Dimension 18: Media Embeds
	gtag('set', 'dimension18', getMediaEmbeds())
	// Dimension 19: Article Slug
	gtag('set', 'dimension19', getMetaValueByName('articleSlug'))
	// Dimension 20: Internal taxonomies
	gtag('set', 'dimension20', getMetaValueByName('internalTaxonomies'))
}

function getUTMQueryParams(queryParams) {
	var utmVariables = [
		'utm_source',
		'utm_medium',
		'utm_campaign',
		'utm_content',
		'utm_term',
	]
	var params = new URLSearchParams(queryParams)
	const normalizedParams = new URLSearchParams(
		Array.from(params, ([key, value]) => [key.toLowerCase(), value])
	)

	return utmVariables
		.filter((variable) => normalizedParams.has(variable))
		.map(
			(variable) =>
				`${variable}=${encodeURIComponent(
					normalizedParams.get(variable)
				)}`
		)
		.join('&')
}

function getUtmParamsObject(queryParams) {
	const utmVariables = [
		'utm_source',
		'utm_medium',
		'utm_campaign',
		'utm_content',
		'utm_term',
	]
	const params = new URLSearchParams(queryParams)
	const normalizedParams = new URLSearchParams(
		Array.from(params, ([key, value]) => [key.toLowerCase(), value])
	)

	return utmVariables
		.filter((variable) => normalizedParams.has(variable))
		.reduce((acc, variable) => {
			acc[variable] = normalizedParams.get(variable)
			return acc
		}, {})
}

function filterAmplitudeEventProperties(eventProperties) {
	var filtered = {}
	Object.keys(eventProperties).forEach(function (key) {
		if (AJ_AMPLITUDE_EVENT_PROPERTY_WHITELIST.indexOf(key) !== -1) {
			filtered[key] = eventProperties[key]
		}
	})
	return filtered
}

// The staged href and location.pathname differ in trailing slash / encoding.
function normalizeAttributionPath(path) {
	if (!path) {
		return ''
	}
	var normalized = path
	try {
		normalized = decodeURIComponent(normalized)
	} catch (e) {}
	return normalized.replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/'
}

function applyPendingAttribution(eventProperties) {
	try {
		var raw = localStorage.getItem(AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_KEY)
		if (!raw) {
			return
		}
		var pending = JSON.parse(raw)
		if (
			!pending.ts ||
			Date.now() - pending.ts > AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_TTL_MS
		) {
			localStorage.removeItem(AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_KEY)
			return
		}
		// Leave another page's payload staged — its tab may still be loading.
		if (
			normalizeAttributionPath(pending.path) !==
			normalizeAttributionPath(window.location.pathname)
		) {
			return
		}

		localStorage.removeItem(AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_KEY)
		for (
			var pendingIndex = 0;
			pendingIndex < AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_PROPERTIES.length;
			pendingIndex++
		) {
			var pendingKey =
				AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_PROPERTIES[pendingIndex]
			if (pending[pendingKey]) {
				eventProperties[pendingKey] = pending[pendingKey]
			}
		}
	} catch (e) {
		// Ignore storage errors.
	}
}

// canonical can be null when  search terms changes
function sendPageView() {
	if (getMetaValue('isPreview') === 'true') {
		// Do not trigger any analytics for preview mode of articles.
		return
	}
	var canonicalNode = documentHead.querySelector('link[rel\x3d"canonical"]')
	var canonical = canonicalNode ? canonicalNode.href : window.location.href
	var pageType = getMetaValue('pageType')
	var section = getMetaValue('pageSection')
	var authors = getMetaValue('pageAuthors')
	var searchTerm = getMetaValue('searchTerms')
	var pageTitle = getMetaValue('pageTitle') || document.title
	var pageTemplate = getMetaValueByName('pageTemplate')
	var path = canonical
	var ga4Canonical = canonical
	var cbPath = path.replace(/(https|http):\/\/(www\.)?/, '')
	var queryParams = window.location.search || ''
	var isProxy =
		window.isDelegatedSite || window.location.hostname.includes('ajnet.me')
			? 'Proxy'
			: 'BaseSite'

	// Search page has a specificity which is defied as :
	// It only has one canonical regardless of the search terms which is /search
	// we use path component to navigate to search terms instead of query params
	// this causes the canonical to not change when search term is updated, therefore page views won't be triggered
	if (searchTerm) {
		ga4Canonical += '?term=' + encodeURIComponent(searchTerm)
	}

	// append any marketing query params to the ga path
	if (queryParams) {
		ga4Canonical =
			ga4Canonical +
			(ga4Canonical.indexOf('?') === -1
				? '?' + getUTMQueryParams(queryParams)
				: '&' + getUTMQueryParams(queryParams))
	}

var CHARTBEAT_SECTION_LIMIT = 10
var CHARTBEAT_AI_SUMMARY_SECTION = 'articleSummaryAvailable'

function chartbeatSectionParts(value) {
	var parts = []
	if (!value) {
		return parts
	}
	var raw = String(value).split(',')
	for (var i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
		if (raw[i] && raw[i] !== CHARTBEAT_AI_SUMMARY_SECTION) {
			parts.push(raw[i])
		}
	}
	return parts
}

function buildChartbeatSections(pageSection, siteModule, includeAiSummary) {
	if (!includeAiSummary) {
		if (!siteModule) {
			return pageSection
		}
		return pageSection
			? pageSection + ',zMod: ' + siteModule
			: 'zMod: ' + siteModule
	}

	var extras = []
	if (siteModule) {
		extras.push('zMod: ' + siteModule)
	}
	extras.push(CHARTBEAT_AI_SUMMARY_SECTION)
	var parts = chartbeatSectionParts(pageSection)
	var room = CHARTBEAT_SECTION_LIMIT - extras.length
	if (parts.length > room) {
		parts = parts.slice(0, room)
	}
	return parts.concat(extras).join(',')

					canonicalPath(window.previousCanonical)
				) {

					// Don't allow observation of other nodes to help avoid double pageviews

function getUTMQueryParams(queryParams) {
	var utmVariables = [
		'utm_source',
		'utm_medium',
		'utm_campaign',
		'utm_content',
		'utm_term',
	]
	var params = new URLSearchParams(queryParams)
	const normalizedParams = new URLSearchParams(
		Array.from(params, ([key, value]) => [key.toLowerCase(), value])
	)

	return utmVariables
		.filter((variable) => normalizedParams.has(variable))
		.map(
			(variable) =>
				`${variable}=${encodeURIComponent(
					normalizedParams.get(variable)
				)}`
		)
		.join('&')
}

function getUtmParamsObject(queryParams) {
	const utmVariables = [
		'utm_source',
		'utm_medium',
		'utm_campaign',
		'utm_content',
		'utm_term',
	]
	const params = new URLSearchParams(queryParams)
	const normalizedParams = new URLSearchParams(
		Array.from(params, ([key, value]) => [key.toLowerCase(), value])
	)

	return utmVariables
		.filter((variable) => normalizedParams.has(variable))
		.reduce((acc, variable) => {
			acc[variable] = normalizedParams.get(variable)
			return acc
		}, {})
}

function filterAmplitudeEventProperties(eventProperties) {
	var filtered = {}
	Object.keys(eventProperties).forEach(function (key) {
		if (AJ_AMPLITUDE_EVENT_PROPERTY_WHITELIST.indexOf(key) !== -1) {
			filtered[key] = eventProperties[key]
		}
	})
	return filtered
}

// The staged href and location.pathname differ in trailing slash / encoding.
function normalizeAttributionPath(path) {
	if (!path) {
		return ''
	}
	var normalized = path
	try {
		normalized = decodeURIComponent(normalized)
	} catch (e) {}
	return normalized.replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/'
}

function applyPendingAttribution(eventProperties) {
	try {
		var raw = localStorage.getItem(AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_KEY)
		if (!raw) {
			return
		}
		var pending = JSON.parse(raw)
		if (
			!pending.ts ||
			Date.now() - pending.ts > AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_TTL_MS
		) {
			localStorage.removeItem(AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_KEY)
			return
		}
		// Leave another page's payload staged — its tab may still be loading.
		if (
			normalizeAttributionPath(pending.path) !==
			normalizeAttributionPath(window.location.pathname)
		) {
			return
		}

		localStorage.removeItem(AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_KEY)
		for (
			var pendingIndex = 0;
			pendingIndex < AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_PROPERTIES.length;
			pendingIndex++
		) {
			var pendingKey =
				AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_PROPERTIES[pendingIndex]
			if (pending[pendingKey]) {
				eventProperties[pendingKey] = pending[pendingKey]
			}
		}
	} catch (e) {
		// Ignore storage errors.
	}
}

// canonical can be null when  search terms changes
function sendPageView() {
	if (getMetaValue('isPreview') === 'true') {
		// Do not trigger any analytics for preview mode of articles.
		return
	}
	var canonicalNode = documentHead.querySelector('link[rel\x3d"canonical"]')
	var canonical = canonicalNode ? canonicalNode.href : window.location.href
	var pageType = getMetaValue('pageType')
	var section = getMetaValue('pageSection')
	var authors = getMetaValue('pageAuthors')
	var searchTerm = getMetaValue('searchTerms')
	var pageTitle = getMetaValue('pageTitle') || document.title
	var pageTemplate = getMetaValueByName('pageTemplate')
	var path = canonical
	var ga4Canonical = canonical
	var cbPath = path.replace(/(https|http):\/\/(www\.)?/, '')
	var queryParams = window.location.search || ''
	var isProxy =
		window.isDelegatedSite || window.location.hostname.includes('ajnet.me')
			? 'Proxy'
			: 'BaseSite'

	// Search page has a specificity which is defied as :
	// It only has one canonical regardless of the search terms which is /search
	// we use path component to navigate to search terms instead of query params
	// this causes the canonical to not change when search term is updated, therefore page views won't be triggered
	if (searchTerm) {
		ga4Canonical += '?term=' + encodeURIComponent(searchTerm)
	}

	// append any marketing query params to the ga path
	if (queryParams) {
		ga4Canonical =
			ga4Canonical +
			(ga4Canonical.indexOf('?') === -1
				? '?' + getUTMQueryParams(queryParams)
				: '&' + getUTMQueryParams(queryParams))
	}

	setCustomDimensions()

	// custom dimensions to be sent as event parameters in GA4
	// only send a custom dimension when it is not empty
	const topics = getMetaValueByName('topics')
	const primaryTopic = getMetaValueByName('primaryTopic')
	const where = getMetaValueByName('where')
	const tags = getMetaValueByName('tags')
	const primaryTag = getMetaValueByName('primaryTag')
	const contentType = getMetaValueByName('contentType')
	const sourceTaxonomy = getMetaValueByName('sourceTaxonomy')
	const taxonomyTerms = getMetaValueByName('taxonomyTerms')
	const displayAuthors = getMetaValueByName('displayAuthors')
	const featuredMedia = getMetaValueByName('featuredMedia')
	const publishedDate = getMetaValueByName('publishedDate')
	const programTaxonomy = getMetaValueByName('programTaxonomy')
	const postID = getMetaValueByName('postID')
	const postLabel = getMetaValueByName('postLabel')
	const lastDate = getMetaValueByName('lastDate')
	const articleSlug = getMetaValueByName('articleSlug')
	const internalTaxonomies = getMetaValueByName('internalTaxonomies')
	const internalReporting = getMetaValueByName('internalReporting')
	const mediaEmbeds = getMediaEmbeds()
	const siteModule = getMetaValue('siteModule')

	var channel = getMetaValueByName('channel')
	const RTLChannels = ['aja']
	const isRTL = RTLChannels.includes(channel)

	var gaEventParams = {
		send_to: getMetaValueByName('ga4'),
		page_title: isRTL ? `\u200f${pageTitle}\u200f` : pageTitle,
		dimension15: 'Web',
		page_location: decodeURI(ga4Canonical),
	}
	const setValidDimension = (dimension, value) => {
		if (value) {
			gaEventParams[dimension] = value
		}
	}
	setValidDimension('dimension1', topics)
	setValidDimension('dimension2', primaryTopic)
	setValidDimension('dimension3', where)
	setValidDimension('dimension4', tags)
	setValidDimension('dimension5', primaryTag)
	setValidDimension('dimension6', contentType)
	setValidDimension('dimension7', sourceTaxonomy)
	setValidDimension('dimension8', taxonomyTerms)
	setValidDimension('dimension9', displayAuthors)
	setValidDimension('dimension10', featuredMedia)
	setValidDimension('dimension11', publishedDate)
	setValidDimension('dimension12', programTaxonomy)
	// Pass Generic Page for pages with default template.
	setValidDimension(
		'dimension13',
		pageTemplate === 'Generic Page' ? pageTemplate : pageType
	)
	setValidDimension('dimension14', postID)
	setValidDimension('dimension16', postLabel)
	setValidDimension('dimension17', lastDate)
	setValidDimension('dimension18', mediaEmbeds)
	setValidDimension('dimension19', articleSlug)
	setValidDimension('dimension20', internalTaxonomies)
	if (internalReporting !== null) {
		setValidDimension('dimension26', internalReporting)
	}

	gtag('event', 'page_view', gaEventParams)

	// AJA only, and only when the summary is approved and actually rendered.
	// The meta is 'false' on every other article; absence of the section is
	// the control group. chartbeat.js loads after this script, so the config
	// has to be written even when its virtual-page API is not up yet — that
	// first beacon is the one engagement is measured on.
	var includeAiSummary =
		channel === 'aja' &&
		getMetaValueByName('articleSummaryAvailable') === 'true'
	var chartSections = buildChartbeatSections(
		section,
		siteModule,
		includeAiSummary
	)

	if (typeof _sf_async_config !== 'undefined' && _sf_async_config) {
		_sf_async_config.title = pageTitle
		_sf_async_config.type = pageType
		_sf_async_config.authors = authors
		_sf_async_config.sections = chartSections
	}

	if (window.pSUPERFLY && window.pSUPERFLY.virtualPage) {
		pSUPERFLY.virtualPage({
			sections: chartSections,
			authors: authors,
			type: pageType,
			title: pageTitle,
			path: cbPath,
		})
	}

	window.previousCanonical = canonical
	window.previousSearchTerm = searchTerm

	// Amplitude handle below:
	const amplitudeLoaded =
		typeof window.amplitude !== 'undefined' &&
		typeof window.amplitude.track !== 'undefined' &&
		typeof window.amplitude.invoked !== 'undefined'

	if (channel && pageTitle) {
		var event = false
		var eventProperties = {}

		const pageList = [
			'Landing Page',
			'Home Page',
			'Search Page',
			'Sitemap Page',
			'Author Page',
			'Sponsored Post',
			'Match Centre',
			'Accounts',
			'404 Page',
			'Staff Directory Page',
		]
		const uCMSAmplitudeVersion = '10.0'

		// A page can opt into the PageOpen branch without claiming a `pageType`.
		// `pageType` is read by GA4 (dimension13) and Chartbeat as well, so a
		// page that only wants the Amplitude event says so here and leaves
		// those two reporting exactly what they reported before.
		const amplitudePageType =
			getMetaValueByName('amplitudePageType') || pageType

		if (pageList.indexOf(amplitudePageType) !== -1) {
			const pageLink =
				getMetaValueByName('pageLink') || window.location.pathname
			eventProperties = {
				channel: channel,
				sourcePlatform: 'Web',
				uCMSAmplitudeVersion: uCMSAmplitudeVersion,
				distribution: isProxy,
				id: getMetaValueByName('postID'),
				referralSource: document.referrer || null,
				link: pageLink,
				// `amplitudeTitle` names the PageOpen alone, for a page whose
				// `pageSection` would otherwise change Chartbeat's sections.
				title: getMetaValueByName('amplitudeTitle') || section || pageTitle,
				type: pageTemplate || amplitudePageType,
				index: getMetaValueByName('position'),
				screenWidth: window.screen.width,
				screenHeight: window.screen.height,
				isMobileExperience: window.screen.width < 769,
				userAgent: window.navigator.userAgent,
				module: getMetaValueByName('module') || getMetaValueByName('siteModule') || getMetaValueByName('recirculationSource'),
				section: getMetaValueByName('siteSection'),
			}

			// Only the reading list emits this meta; other pages must not carry a null.
			var readingListTopics = getMetaValueByName('readingListTopics')
			if (readingListTopics !== null) {
				eventProperties.readingListTopics = readingListTopics
			}
			event = 'PageOpen'
		} else if (pageType === 'Article Page') {
			let attributionToken = getMetaValueByName('attributionToken')
			// If the attributionToken is not set, try to get it from the query params
			if (!attributionToken) {
				attributionToken =
					new URLSearchParams(queryParams).get('attrToken') || null
			}

			eventProperties = {
				channel: channel,
				sourcePlatform: 'Web',
				uCMSAmplitudeVersion: uCMSAmplitudeVersion,
				distribution: isProxy,
				id: getMetaValueByName('postID'),
				type: getMetaValueByName('contentType'),
				tag: getMetaValueByName('tags'),
				where: getMetaValueByName('where'),
				topics: getMetaValueByName('topics'),
				trendingList: getMetaValueByName('taxonomy-trending'),
				link: getMetaValueByName('postLink'),
				title: isRTL ? `\u200f${pageTitle}\u200f` : pageTitle,
				date: getMetaValueByName('publishedDate'),
				author: getMetaValueByName('displayAuthors'),
				videoEmbedded: getMetaValue('hasVideo', 'name', false)
					? 'Yes'
					: 'No',
				carouselEmbedded:
					getMetaValue('hasCarousel', 'name', false) === 'true',
				commentsEnabled: !!getMetaValue(
					'commentsEnabled',
					'name',
					false
				),
				referralSource: document.referrer.includes(
					'OneSignalSDKWorker.js'
				)
					? 'WebPushNotification'
					: document.referrer || null,
				module: getMetaValueByName('module') || getMetaValueByName('siteModule') || getMetaValueByName('recirculationSource'),
				section: getMetaValueByName('section') || getMetaValueByName('siteSection'),
				index: getMetaValueByName('position') || getMetaValueByName('articlePosition'),
				screenWidth: window.screen.width,
				screenHeight: window.screen.height,
				isMobileExperience: window.screen.width < 769,
				userAgent: window.navigator.userAgent,
				...(attributionToken && {
					attributionToken: attributionToken,
				}),
				...getUtmParamsObject(queryParams),
				articleListenOption: getMetaValueByName('articleListenOption'),
			}

			if (internalReporting !== null) {
				eventProperties.internalReporting = internalReporting
			}

			// Only the v2 build emits this meta. Reading it unguarded would stamp a
			// null onto every v1 ArticleOpen, where there is no summary to report on.
			var summaryAvailable = getMetaValueByName('articleSummaryAvailable')
			if (summaryAvailable !== null) {
				eventProperties.articleSummaryAvailable = summaryAvailable
			}

			// v2 only, like the summary flag above.
			var layoutName = getMetaValueByName('layoutName')
			if (layoutName !== null) {
				eventProperties.layoutName = layoutName
			}

			// v2 only, and only while the homepage article panel shows the
			// article; a page reports none.
			var presentation = getMetaValueByName('presentation')
			if (presentation !== null) {
				eventProperties.presentation = presentation
			}

			// A v2 article opened from a rail on another article. Gated on the
			// referring path so every other open keeps the payload it has: the
			// `recirculationSource` meta is on v1 pages too, folded into `module`.
			// `section` belongs to section pages, so an article-to-article
			// click reports none.
			var previousPageLink = getMetaValueByName('previousPageLink')
			if (previousPageLink !== null) {
				eventProperties.previousPageLink = previousPageLink
				eventProperties.recirculationSource =
					getMetaValueByName('recirculationSource')
				eventProperties.section = null
				var recirculationLocation = getMetaValueByName(
					'recirculationLocation'
				)
				if (recirculationLocation !== null) {
					eventProperties.location = recirculationLocation
				}
			}

			// The v2 For You tab's placements. Keyed on the module, not the
			// section: v1's For You tab sends that section too, and its
			// ArticleOpen must stay as it is.
			var isForYouPlacement =
				String(eventProperties.module || '').indexOf('For You - ') === 0

			// The Latest tab's, reading list's and For You tab's specs name the
			// row's place `position`; every other surface reports it as `index`
			// alone, and its dashboards read that.
			// A number, as the Latest `ButtonPress` sends it; `index` stays the
			// meta's string.
			if (
				(eventProperties.module === 'Latest' ||
					eventProperties.module === 'Reading List' ||
					isForYouPlacement) &&
				eventProperties.index
			) {
				var rowPosition = Number(eventProperties.index)
				if (!Number.isNaN(rowPosition)) {
					eventProperties.position = rowPosition
				}
			}

			// Layout context is for the homepage and the section pages'
			// containers and feed, and the column index is the Arabic
			// right-to-left convention. Only v2 emits these metas, so v1's
			// Featured and Feed opens keep the ArticleOpen they already send.
			// The card's place stays `index`; numeric `position` is the Latest
			// tab's name for it.
			if (
				(eventProperties.section === 'Homepage' ||
					eventProperties.module === 'Featured' ||
					eventProperties.module === 'Feed') &&
				String(channel).toLowerCase() === 'aja'
			) {
				var containerType = getMetaValueByName('containerType')
				var cardType = getMetaValueByName('cardType')
				var columnPosition = Number(getMetaValueByName('columnPosition'))
				var cardPosition = Number(getMetaValueByName('cardPosition'))
				if (containerType) eventProperties.containerType = containerType
				if (cardType) eventProperties.cardType = cardType
				if (columnPosition > 0) {
					eventProperties.columnPosition = columnPosition
				}
				if (cardPosition > 0) {
					eventProperties.cardPosition = cardPosition
				}
			}

			// The For You tab's card format, and the followed topic a topic
			// carousel draws from.
			if (isForYouPlacement) {
				var forYouCardType = getMetaValueByName('cardType')
				var topicId = getMetaValueByName('topicId')
				var carouselType = getMetaValueByName('carouselType')
				if (forYouCardType) eventProperties.cardType = forYouCardType
				if (topicId) eventProperties.topicId = topicId
				if (carouselType) eventProperties.carouselType = carouselType
			}

			event = 'ArticleOpen'
		}

		/**
		 * Add any additional data to the event properties.
		 * Currently using this for the sub nav analytics data.
		 * But it can be used for other data as well.
		 */
		const ajAnalyticsData = window.ajAnalyticsData || {}

		if (ajAnalyticsData.type === 'click') {
			eventProperties = {
				...eventProperties,
				...ajAnalyticsData.data,
			}

			// Delete the ajAnalyticsData after processing it.
			delete window.ajAnalyticsData
		}

		applyPendingAttribution(eventProperties)

		try {
			var redirectData = sessionStorage.getItem(
				AJ_ANALYTICS_REDIRECT_DATA_KEY
			)
			if (redirectData) {
				sessionStorage.removeItem(AJ_ANALYTICS_REDIRECT_DATA_KEY)
				var parsed = JSON.parse(redirectData)
				if (parsed.module) {
					eventProperties.module = parsed.module
				}
			}
		} catch (e) {
			// Ignore storage errors.
		}

		let signinStatus = getMetaValueByName('user:signinStatus')
		let verificationStatus = getMetaValueByName('user:verificationStatus')
		let authType = getMetaValueByName('user:signInMethod')

		const localStorageKeys = Object.keys(window.localStorage)
		const firebaseUserKey = localStorageKeys.find((key) =>
			key.startsWith('firebase:authUser:')
		)

		if (
			(!signinStatus || signinStatus === 'Signed Out') &&
			firebaseUserKey
		) {
			let userData

			try {
				userData = JSON.parse(
					window.localStorage.getItem(firebaseUserKey)
				)
			} catch (e) {
				console.error('Error parsing user data.', e)
			}

			if (userData) {
				signinStatus = 'Signed In'
				verificationStatus = userData.emailVerified
					? 'Verified'
					: 'Not Verified'
			}
		}

		if (!authType) {
			authType = window.localStorage.getItem('userSignInMethod')
		}

		eventProperties.signinStatus = signinStatus || 'Signed Out'
		eventProperties.verificationStatus =
			verificationStatus || 'Not Verified'
		eventProperties.authType = authType || 'none'

		// Send chartbeat signinstatus.
		var chartBeatSigninStatus =
			signinStatus === 'Signed In' ? 'lgdin' : 'anon'
		var _cbq = (window._cbq = window._cbq || [])
		_cbq.push(['_acct', chartBeatSigninStatus])

		const pageViewChangeEvent = new Event('analytics:page-view-change')
		window.dispatchEvent(pageViewChangeEvent)

		eventProperties = filterAmplitudeEventProperties(eventProperties)

		if (amplitudeLoaded && event) {
			// amplitudeLoaded is for CSR when amplitude is loaded and send the event right away.
			window.amplitude.track(event, eventProperties)
		} else if (event) {
			// For SSR this will sent later when amplitude is loaded.
			window.amplitudeOpenEvent = {
				event: event,
				eventProperties: eventProperties,
			}
		}
	}
}

function getUTMQueryParams(queryParams) {
	var utmVariables = [
		'utm_source',
		'utm_medium',
		'utm_campaign',
		'utm_content',
		'utm_term',
	]
	var params = new URLSearchParams(queryParams)
	const normalizedParams = new URLSearchParams(
		Array.from(params, ([key, value]) => [key.toLowerCase(), value])
	)

	return utmVariables
		.filter((variable) => normalizedParams.has(variable))
		.map(
			(variable) =>
				`${variable}=${encodeURIComponent(
					normalizedParams.get(variable)
				)}`
		)
		.join('&')
}

function getUtmParamsObject(queryParams) {
	const utmVariables = [
		'utm_source',
		'utm_medium',
		'utm_campaign',
		'utm_content',
		'utm_term',
	]
	const params = new URLSearchParams(queryParams)
	const normalizedParams = new URLSearchParams(
		Array.from(params, ([key, value]) => [key.toLowerCase(), value])
	)

	return utmVariables
		.filter((variable) => normalizedParams.has(variable))
		.reduce((acc, variable) => {
			acc[variable] = normalizedParams.get(variable)
			return acc
		}, {})
}

function filterAmplitudeEventProperties(eventProperties) {
	var filtered = {}
	Object.keys(eventProperties).forEach(function (key) {
		if (AJ_AMPLITUDE_EVENT_PROPERTY_WHITELIST.indexOf(key) !== -1) {
			filtered[key] = eventProperties[key]
		}
	})
	return filtered
}

// The staged href and location.pathname differ in trailing slash / encoding.
function normalizeAttributionPath(path) {
	if (!path) {
		return ''
	}
	var normalized = path
	try {
		normalized = decodeURIComponent(normalized)
	} catch (e) {}
	return normalized.replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/'
}

function applyPendingAttribution(eventProperties) {
	try {
		var raw = localStorage.getItem(AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_KEY)
		if (!raw) {
			return
		}
		var pending = JSON.parse(raw)
		if (
			!pending.ts ||
			Date.now() - pending.ts > AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_TTL_MS
		) {
			localStorage.removeItem(AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_KEY)
			return
		}
		// Leave another page's payload staged — its tab may still be loading.
		if (
			normalizeAttributionPath(pending.path) !==
			normalizeAttributionPath(window.location.pathname)
		) {
			return
		}

		localStorage.removeItem(AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_KEY)
		for (
			var pendingIndex = 0;
			pendingIndex < AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_PROPERTIES.length;
			pendingIndex++
		) {
			var pendingKey =
				AJ_ANALYTICS_PENDING_ATTRIBUTION_PROPERTIES[pendingIndex]
			if (pending[pendingKey]) {
				eventProperties[pendingKey] = pending[pendingKey]
			}
		}
	} catch (e) {
		// Ignore storage errors.
	}
}

// canonical can be null when  search terms changes
function sendPageView() {

		return
	}

	var canonical = canonicalNode ? canonicalNode.href : window.location.href
	var pageType = getMetaValue('pageType')
	var section = getMetaValue('pageSection')
	var authors = getMetaValue('pageAuthors')
	var searchTerm = getMetaValue('searchTerms')

	var pageTemplate = getMetaValueByName('pageTemplate')

			? 'Proxy'

	// It only has one canonical regardless of the search terms which is /search
	// we use path component to navigate to search terms instead of query params
	// this causes the canonical to not change when search term is updated, therefore page views won't be triggered
	if (searchTerm) {
		ga4Canonical += '?term=' + encodeURIComponent(searchTerm)
	}

	if (queryParams) {
		ga4Canonical =
			ga4Canonical +
			(ga4Canonical.indexOf('?') === -1
				? '?' + getUTMQueryParams(queryParams)
				: '&' + getUTMQueryParams(queryParams))

	// only send a custom dimension when it is not empty
	const topics = getMetaValueByName('topics')
	const primaryTopic = getMetaValueByName('primaryTopic')
	const where = getMetaValueByName('where')
	const tags = getMetaValueByName('tags')
	const primaryTag = getMetaValueByName('primaryTag')
	const contentType = getMetaValueByName('contentType')
	const sourceTaxonomy = getMetaValueByName('sourceTaxonomy')
	const taxonomyTerms = getMetaValueByName('taxonomyTerms')
	const displayAuthors = getMetaValueByName('displayAuthors')
	const featuredMedia = getMetaValueByName('featuredMedia')
	const publishedDate = getMetaValueByName('publishedDate')
	const programTaxonomy = getMetaValueByName('programTaxonomy')
	const postID = getMetaValueByName('postID')
	const postLabel = getMetaValueByName('postLabel')
	const lastDate = getMetaValueByName('lastDate')
	const articleSlug = getMetaValueByName('articleSlug')
	const internalTaxonomies = getMetaValueByName('internalTaxonomies')
	const internalReporting = getMetaValueByName('internalReporting')
	const mediaEmbeds = getMediaEmbeds()
	const siteModule = getMetaValue('siteModule')

	const RTLChannels = ['aja']
	const isRTL = RTLChannels.includes(channel)

	var gaEventParams = {
		send_to: getMetaValueByName('ga4'),
		page_title: isRTL ? `\u200f${pageTitle}\u200f` : pageTitle,
		dimension15: 'Web',
		page_location: decodeURI(ga4Canonical),
	}
	const setValidDimension = (dimension, value) => {
		if (value) {
			gaEventParams[dimension] = value
		}
	}
	setValidDimension('dimension1', topics)
	setValidDimension('dimension2', primaryTopic)
	setValidDimension('dimension3', where)
	setValidDimension('dimension4', tags)
	setValidDimension('dimension5', primaryTag)
	setValidDimension('dimension6', contentType)
	setValidDimension('dimension7', sourceTaxonomy)
	setValidDimension('dimension8', taxonomyTerms)
	setValidDimension('dimension9', displayAuthors)
	setValidDimension('dimension10', featuredMedia)
	setValidDimension('dimension11', publishedDate)
	setValidDimension('dimension12', programTaxonomy)
	// Pass Generic Page for pages with default template.
	setValidDimension(
		'dimension13',
		pageTemplate === 'Generic Page' ? pageTemplate : pageType
	)
	setValidDimension('dimension14', postID)
	setValidDimension('dimension16', postLabel)
	setValidDimension('dimension17', lastDate)
	setValidDimension('dimension18', mediaEmbeds)
	setValidDimension('dimension19', articleSlug)
	setValidDimension('dimension20', internalTaxonomies)
	if (internalReporting !== null) {
		setValidDimension('dimension26', internalReporting)
	}

	// The meta is 'false' on every other article; absence of the section is
	// the control group. chartbeat.js loads after this script, so the config
	// has to be written even when its virtual-page API is not up yet — that
	// first beacon is the one engagement is measured on.
	var includeAiSummary =
		channel === 'aja' &&
		getMetaValueByName('articleSummaryAvailable') === 'true'
	var chartSections = buildChartbeatSections(
		section,
		siteModule,
		includeAiSummary
	)

	if (typeof _sf_async_config !== 'undefined' && _sf_async_config) {
		_sf_async_config.title = pageTitle
		_sf_async_config.type = pageType
		_sf_async_config.authors = authors
		_sf_async_config.sections = chartSections
	}

	window.previousSearchTerm = searchTerm

		typeof window.amplitude !== 'undefined' &&
		typeof window.amplitude.track !== 'undefined' &&
		typeof window.amplitude.invoked !== 'undefined'

		var event = false
		var eventProperties = {}

			'Landing Page',
			'Home Page',
			'Search Page',
			'Sitemap Page',
			'Author Page',

				sourcePlatform: 'Web',
				uCMSAmplitudeVersion: uCMSAmplitudeVersion,
				distribution: isProxy,
				id: getMetaValueByName('postID'),
				referralSource: document.referrer || null,
				link: pageLink,
				// `amplitudeTitle` names the PageOpen alone, for a page whose
				// `pageSection` would otherwise change Chartbeat's sections.

				type: pageTemplate || amplitudePageType,
				index: getMetaValueByName('position'),
				screenWidth: window.screen.width,
				screenHeight: window.screen.height,
				isMobileExperience: window.screen.width < 769,
				userAgent: window.navigator.userAgent,
				module: getMetaValueByName('module') || getMetaValueByName('siteModule') || getMetaValueByName('recirculationSource'),
				section: getMetaValueByName('siteSection'),
			}

			// Only the reading list emits this meta; other pages must not carry a null.
			var readingListTopics = getMetaValueByName('readingListTopics')
			if (readingListTopics !== null) {
				eventProperties.readingListTopics = readingListTopics
			}
			event = 'PageOpen'

			let attributionToken = getMetaValueByName('attributionToken')
			// If the attributionToken is not set, try to get it from the query params
			if (!attributionToken) {
				attributionToken =
					new URLSearchParams(queryParams).get('attrToken') || null
			}

			eventProperties = {
				channel: channel,
				sourcePlatform: 'Web',
				uCMSAmplitudeVersion: uCMSAmplitudeVersion,
				distribution: isProxy,
				id: getMetaValueByName('postID'),
				type: getMetaValueByName('contentType'),
				tag: getMetaValueByName('tags'),
				where: getMetaValueByName('where'),
				topics: getMetaValueByName('topics'),
				trendingList: getMetaValueByName('taxonomy-trending'),
				link: getMetaValueByName('postLink'),
				title: isRTL ? `\u200f${pageTitle}\u200f` : pageTitle,
				date: getMetaValueByName('publishedDate'),
				author: getMetaValueByName('displayAuthors'),
				videoEmbedded: getMetaValue('hasVideo', 'name', false)
					? 'Yes'
					: 'No',
				carouselEmbedded:
					getMetaValue('hasCarousel', 'name', false) === 'true',
				commentsEnabled: !!getMetaValue(
					'commentsEnabled',
					'name',
					false
				),
				referralSource: document.referrer.includes(
					'OneSignalSDKWorker.js'
				)
					? 'WebPushNotification'
					: document.referrer || null,
				module: getMetaValueByName('module') || getMetaValueByName('siteModule') || getMetaValueByName('recirculationSource'),
				section: getMetaValueByName('section') || getMetaValueByName('siteSection'),
				index: getMetaValueByName('position') || getMetaValueByName('articlePosition'),
				screenWidth: window.screen.width,
				screenHeight: window.screen.height,
				isMobileExperience: window.screen.width < 769,
				userAgent: window.navigator.userAgent,
				...(attributionToken && {
					attributionToken: attributionToken,

				...getUtmParamsObject(queryParams),

			// row's place `position`; every other surface reports it as `index`
			// alone, and its dashboards read that.
			// A number, as the Latest `ButtonPress` sends it; `index` stays the
			// meta's string.
			if (
				(eventProperties.module === 'Latest' ||
					eventProperties.module === 'Reading List' ||

				var columnPosition = Number(getMetaValueByName('columnPosition'))
				var cardPosition = Number(getMetaValueByName('cardPosition'))
				if (containerType) eventProperties.containerType = containerType
				if (cardType) eventProperties.cardType = cardType
				if (columnPosition > 0) {

				}

					eventProperties.cardPosition = cardPosition

				if (forYouCardType) eventProperties.cardType = forYouCardType

		let verificationStatus = getMetaValueByName('user:verificationStatus')
		let authType = getMetaValueByName('user:signInMethod')

		const localStorageKeys = Object.keys(window.localStorage)
		const firebaseUserKey = localStorageKeys.find((key) =>
			key.startsWith('firebase:authUser:')
		)

		if (
			(!signinStatus || signinStatus === 'Signed Out') &&
			firebaseUserKey
		) {
			let userData

			try {

					window.localStorage.getItem(firebaseUserKey)

			window.amplitudeOpenEvent = {
				event: event,
				eventProperties: eventProperties,
			}
		}
	}
}
